capabilities: Sync saved links, summaries, and highlights from Linkwise into vault notes
Map each Linkwise collection to a vault folder with a managed Map of Content note
Preserve highlight colors via CSS styling and frontmatter for filtering
Protect user-written text below the '## My Notes' heading during sync
Add graph color groups so collection hub notes stand out in the graph view
disambiguation: Not a tool for managing or checking links inside your notes; it imports content from the Linkwise read-later service.
extras: Sync is one-way (Linkwise to vault); the README documents a known limitation where individually deleted highlights only disappear after the parent article re-syncs. Not reviewed by Obsidian staff per the manifest.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull a read-later service's saved links, highlights, and summaries into native notes.

relations.evidence: The official Obsidian integration for Linkwise.

summary: Official integration that syncs Linkwise saved links, AI summaries, highlights, and collections into the vault as Markdown notes.
